about: The audit after (A), coordinator ruling 2026-11-20 (fix/headless-per-bar-clock-codes): five chart-clock codes that withhold only some bars (bar-index:early-bars, bar-index:first-bar, running-total:early-bars, window-extreme:left-edge, request:htf-newest-unconfirmed) write their bars to the plot's per-bar channel and are in interpret.js::PER_BAR_CLOCK_CODES, so the headless lane (Inspect a bar) computes the script and names them per output; every other code, var-origin:window the control, still refuses whole.

mutants.mutant: bar-index mask: its codes' bars never written (the headless lane fails closed and refuses)
mutants.from: for (const [code, bars0] of byCode) sinkPerBar(opts, code, bars0)

mutants.mutant: window-hole mask: its bars never written
mutants.from: for (const code of codes) sinkPerBar(opts, code, mask)

mutants.mutant: merge mask: the newest bars never written
the list without bar-index:first-bar (that code refused whole again)
